children: Micron is building one of the largest semiconductor factories in US history in Syracuse, New York, a city that lost jobs after companies including GE, Carrier and General Motors left, according to Bloomberg.

Rob Simpson of CenterState CEO discusses what drew Micron to Syracuse, local business owner Darin Price describes the investment’s impact on the ground, and Brookings economist Joseph Parilla says Syracuse could serve as a model for reindustrialization across America.

title: Micron’s Syracuse Chip Plant Could Aid Rust Belt Revival
